about.title: Our leaders studied construction at the University of Houston
text: In 2008, Jay Dorsey and a partner established Triad Retail Construction in Pearland, Texas.

Jay Dorsey, our President, graduated from the University of Houston in Construction Management and Surveying, and Hernan Morales, our Chief Executive Officer, graduated from there in Construction Management. David Hodges joined us as in-house General Counsel and a senior executive.

Our clients include Fortune 500 retail chains and developers, and we now work across 41 states including Puerto Rico. New employees get hands-on mentoring from day one, and we count innovation, hard work and integrity as the keys to our success.
